about_the_game:
Far from the comforts of the village, a fearless cow sets off on an unexpected journey — dashing across treacherous farm platforms in search of her lost calf, hidden somewhere within the ruins of an ancient barn.

The path ahead is filled with danger. Crafty farmers have rigged traps, sly foes lie in ambush behind hay bales, and spinning blades, collapsing crates, and crumbling platforms stand ready to end your adventure at every step. This is no peaceful countryside — and she’s far from an ordinary cow.

Your goal is to guide her through each hazardous level, pushing crates to build paths, dodging deadly mechanisms, and outsmarting those who stand in her way. Every movement counts — one misstep could send her plummeting into the abyss or straight into a blade.

The Farm Racing fuses classic platforming action with clever environmental puzzles. Some objects can be moved, others remain fixed — it’s up to you to figure out which to trust. Quick reflexes and sharp logic will be the key to survival.

Can you outsmart the dangers of the farm and reunite mother and calf?

Key Features:

  • Fast-paced platform gameplay mixed with puzzle-solving challenges

  • Over 30 handcrafted stages full of traps, surprises, and farm-themed hazards

  • Beautiful 2D art style inspired by medieval rural life
